description:
Forged in a star

A star's core. Three helium nuclei fuse into one carbon nucleus: three helium-4 make carbon-12. The carbon drifts out through a nebula and into a living cell, then becomes a letter C with four electrons around it. Text: Every carbon atom in you was forged in a star. Organic chemistry is what that carbon learned to do next.
